[P1] Sandwich bread
Some sandwich breads are designed for use in the creation of specific types of sandwiches , such as the submarine sandwich . For barbecuing , use of a high-quality white sandwich bread has been described as suitable for toasting over a fire . Gluten-free sandwich bread may be prepared using gluten-free flour , teff flour . and other ingredients .

[P2] Rice bread
Rice bread is a type of bread that is made from rice flour rather than wheat flour . Being gluten free , it will not cause adverse reactions for people with gluten intolerance . The Vietnamese banh mi ( baguette ) is traditionally made with a mixture of wheat and rice flour or sometimes the latter , resulting in an airy , crispy texture . Reinhart is considered to be one of the most respected baking educators in America . He is also the founder of Brother Juniper 's Bakery in Santa Rosa , California ( since closed ) . Currently , he serves as full-time Chef on Assignment at Johnson & Wales University .

[P4] Gluten-free, casein-free diet
Gluten-free casein-free diet ( GFCF diet ) , also known as gluten-free dairy-free diet ( GFDF diet , is a diet that does not include the proteins gluten ( found most often in wheat , barley , and rye ) , and casein ( found most often in milk and dairy products ) . Despite an absence of scientific evidence , there have been advocates for the use of this diet as a treatment for autism and related conditions .

[P5] Secalin
Secalin is a prolamin glyco-protein found in the grain rye , Secale cereale . Secalin is one of the forms of gluten proteins that people with coeliac disease can not tolerate , and thus rye should be avoided by people with this disease . It is generally recommended that such people follow a gluten free diet . In bread making with rye flour , this protein requires exposure to an acid such as lactic acid to make the bread rise . This is usually achieved with a sourdough ferment .
